dba_description: Taskgen only: generate one resource_cpu injection task. The LLM must directly generate a ChaosBlade raw_command TaskSpec for bounded CPU pressure, including a unique --uid and matching cleanup_command; command[0] and cleanup_command[0] must be the configured DBMAGS_CHAOSBLADE_PATH/RuntimeConfig.chaosblade_path, not bare blade. Do not execute the task.
